reviews.title: Rugged, over engineered, quality parts, cannot be destroyed
reviews.comment: My three thousand dollar gaming PC only draws about 500 watts, why did I buy this monster? Well, it quietly hums under a 40 percent load, it is fully modular and it supports the newer high wattage GPU connection, so instead of two cables and a Y adapter you use one high wattage cable. Clean cable management , quiet, quality over engineered parts and numerous connections for potential future expansion. Even though I am a heavy gamer, this power supply cannot be hurt. You can achieve the same result with something cheaper but I don't want to protect JUST the power supply, I want my other components to last long as well. A monster brick that's barely sipping juice cannot be destroyed. This is a very good purchase.
reviews.author: Eggs OMalley

reviews.title: My go to power supply
reviews.comment: I bought my first Be Quiet power supply about 2 years ago, and I have bought 2 others since. They really are quiet. You pretty much have to stick your ear right next to them to hear them even under a heavy load from the GPU. Basically you can't hear them over the GPU fans. Power delivery is rock solid. I have the 1500 watt because I run an RTX 3090 Ti, RTX 4080 Super, and RTX 4090. The power supply comes with the PCIe 5 power cable too. There really isn't much difference in price between the 1500 and 1200, and since both are extremely power efficient, the cost to run the 1500 is very little extra per month. This is the only brand I will be buying from now on.
reviews.author: Morris L.
